title: Kenyan-Style Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry inspired by Kenyan cuisine, made vegan. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the Kenyan spices and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the snow peas and cook until tender but still crisp, about 3 minutes.
Add the savory tofu and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the tofu is heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
